title: Cola2: Co-Adaptive Hierarchical Language Modeling with Continuous Semantic Compression and Balanced Discrete Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31305v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hierarchical language generation separates continuous semantic modeling from discrete text realization, but its effectiveness depends on what the latent space compresses and how the discrete generator uses it. We propose Cola2, a framework that jointly studies continuous semantic compression, the balance between reconstruction and generation, and continuous-discrete co-adaptation. Cola2 dynamically segments text into semantic spans, controls the compression rate through auxiliary-loss-free negative feedback, and combines reconstruction and generation supervision to learn compact, predictive latent representations. A block-causal masked diffusion decoder is trained with clean, noisy, and dropped latent conditions, while classifier-free guidance adjusts the balance between semantic reconstruction and autonomous generation. translated_title: Cola2：具有连续语义压缩与平衡离散生成的协同自适应分层语言建模
translated_abstract: 分层语言生成将连续语义建模与离散文本实现分离开来，但其有效性取决于潜在空间压缩了什么内容，以及离散生成器如何利用这些内容。我们提出 Cola2，这是一个联合研究连续语义压缩、重建与生成之间的平衡以及连续-离散协同适应的框架。Cola2 动态地将文本分割为语义片段，通过无辅助损失的负反馈机制控制压缩率，并结合重建与生成两种监督信号来学习紧凑且具有预测性的潜在表示。块因果掩码扩散解码器在干净、带噪以及缺失的潜在条件下进行训练，同时无分类器引导调节语义重建与自主生成之间的平衡。词元预测梯度通过潜在表示更新编码器，而流匹配先验学习则被解耦……
tldr: Cola2 提出了一种协同自适应的分层语言建模框架，通过动态语义分段和无辅助损失的负反馈来控制连续语义压缩率，并结合块因果掩码扩散解码器与无分类器引导，实现语义重建与自主生成之间的平衡。
en_tdlr: Cola2 is a co-adaptive hierarchical language modeling framework that dynamically compresses text into compact latent semantics via auxiliary-loss-free negative feedback, and employs a block-causal masked diffusion decoder with classifier-free guidance to balance semantic reconstruction and autonomous generation.
